concepts.def: All living organisms are composed of cells; cells are the smallest unit of life; cells arise from pre-existing cells (Schleiden, Schwann 1838-39; Virchow 1858).
Cell without membrane-bound nucleus or organelles; DNA in nucleoid; includes bacteria and archaea.
Cell with membrane-bound nucleus and organelles; includes protists, fungi, plants, animals.
Phospholipid bilayer with embedded proteins; selectively permeable (Singer & Nicolson 1972).
Mitochondria and chloroplasts originated from free-living prokaryotes engulfed by ancestral eukaryotes (Margulis 1967).
As cells grow, volume increases faster than surface area, limiting diffusion; drives mitotic division.
